propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into worktree HEAD via git merge, making the heal result dependent on the checked-out branch and causing _require_tracker_on_ref to refuse heals when current_branch != ref
The heal should fold heads into refs/heads/<ref> tip using git merge-tree --write-tree and git commit-tree, independent of the worktree's checked-out branch
A tracker with a different branch checked out or in detached HEAD state should heal successfully without refusal
The merge=ours driver policy (.bridge_state/* merge=ours) must be honored during the fold and has no existing test coverage
After an on-branch heal, index and worktree must be consistent with the moved ref; after an off-branch heal, the checked-out branch and worktree must remain unchanged
